video.title: 37% Joined. Then 86% Did. Only the Default Changed.

elements.content: 37% of new hires joined their savings plan.
Same company. Same plan. Only the default changed.
Before, you had to sign up.
After, you were signed up unless you opted out.
That was one company, in a 2001 study.
And the catch: most of them never raised the low default.
If you save what's left, what's left is often nothing.
So make saving your default: schedule a small transfer for payday,
Try it today: schedule one tiny transfer for your next payday.
